title: fix: photo credits are cut off on iPhone; replace inline toggle with a shared credits sheet
body:
On iPhone the photo credits list is not fully visible after tapping the toggle. On the results screen the "Hide photo credits · 9" list runs past the bottom of the screen and the last entries (e.g. 23 Ferland Mendy) are clipped.

## Proposed change
- Replace the inline show/hide list with a bar/sheet that opens over the rest of the screen.
- It grows to the height the full credit list needs, scrolling only if the list is taller than the screen.
- Build it as one shared component, so the Study screen can reuse it when photos appear there (v2.0.0 "Study as player cards").

## Constraints (CLAUDE.md)
- Every shown photo keeps its credit (guardrail 1).
- Never show the Commons file name or caption.
- Colours, spacing and font sizes come from tokens via `useThemeColors()`.
- Any animation stays under 300ms.
- Check on a real iPhone, in light and dark themes.

**Size: M** (set manually on the project board; Projects API unavailable from the creating session)
